description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV1 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It uses Google Test framework to verify reading video and audio data segments, including setting up shared memory, writing frames, and validating the read data.

classes.name: DataReaderV1Tests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing DataReaderV1's functionality of reading media data from shared memory buffers.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Sets environment variable and initializes media segments with data before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Unsets environment variable after each test.

methods.name: writeVideoData
methods.description: Prepares shared memory and writes a video frame into it.

methods.name: readVideoData
methods.description: Reads and verifies the video data segment from shared memory.

methods.name: writeAudioData
methods.description: Prepares shared memory and writes an audio frame into it.

methods.name: readAudioData
methods.description: Reads and verifies the audio data segment from shared memory.
